memory.summary:
On December 16th, Andy has multiple conversations. At various times, he discusses the AI project meeting with Peter. The meeting, originally scheduled for December 17th at Caroline's Café, is now set to take place on December 20th at the community garden instead. Andy invites Noor to join and proposes discussing a musical collaboration over coffee at Caroline's Café the following day. They also plan for a lunch with Diego and Samantha the day after that.

Peter is enthusiastic about this idea and proposes a meeting at Caroline's Café next Tuesday, December 17th, at 1 PM to discuss it further. Andy also invites Peter to join Diego and Samantha for lunch the following day, and they recall their dinner plans on October 31st.
